description: This file defines a library of vertex conversion classes used for buffer conversion in graphics rendering, including templates for type casting, normalization, widening, default values, and vertex data conversion.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: Template struct for identity transformation of a type.

classes.name: Cast
classes.description: Template struct for casting between different types.

classes.name: Normalize
classes.description: Template struct for normalizing numeric types to float.

classes.name: FixedToFloat
classes.description: Template struct for converting fixed-point values to float.

classes.name: NoWiden
classes.description: Template struct indicating no widening of component size.

classes.name: WidenToEven
classes.description: Template struct for widening components to an even number.

classes.name: WidenToFour
classes.description: Template struct for widening components to four.

classes.name: SimpleDefaultValues
classes.description: Template struct providing default zero and one values for types.

classes.name: NormalizedDefaultValues
classes.description: Template struct providing default zero and max values for normalized types.

classes.name: VertexDataConverter
classes.description: Template struct for converting arrays of vertex data with support for widening, default values, and type conversion.
